title: No test gate blocks a production deploy
evidence: CLAUDE.md: Railway auto-deploys every main push, CI or not
current_behavior: Railway ships every main push; GitHub Actions assigns no runner since ~2026-10-28 19:50 UTC; main is unprotected, so even a running CI is advisory.
expected_behavior: Required status checks (Backend CI test/pip-audit/docker-build, Evaluation regression gate, Repo Hygiene) on a protected main, and Railway waiting for CI.
recommendation: Owner restores Actions, protects main with required checks, enables Railway 'Wait for CI' or disables its auto-deploy; record both settings in docs/reports/.

title: Every AI-quality gate is scripted; no real-model evaluation exists or is scheduled
current_behavior: Gates use EchoProvider, ContextGroundedProvider and the non-semantic hash embedder; agent_tasks 100% is tautological; production embedder/LLM quality has never been measured.
expected_behavior: A scheduled real-model evaluation (production embedder + the deployed model) reporting recall@10, groundedness and citation precision per PRODUCTION_SLO, committed to docs/reports/.
recommendation: Add a schedule/dispatch job running evaluation/runner.py and evaluation/vision_eval.py against the dev stack with AURA_LLM_PROVIDERS set (outside gate.py's determinism check); commit the first report; then gate releases on it. Fits ADR-003/030 (local-first, hosted only behind the flag).

title: Windows coverage for the Windows-first desktop targets is advisory only
current_behavior: Known Windows failures (10 client path_containment cases, 5 hostd cases: 8.3 short paths, errno 32 locks) cannot turn a run red.
recommendation: Fix the 8.3 path canonicalisation in client and hostd tests, verify a green run, then remove continue-on-error.

title: Host Daemon CI hangs on Linux; the fix has never been CI-run
current_behavior: Linux job passes 220 tests then the PosixPtySession reader isolate hangs until the 15-minute timeout; fix merged with no runner since.
expected_behavior: Green Linux Host Daemon CI run.
recommendation: Re-run on main once runners return; if it still hangs, tag posix_pty_session_test.dart and run it with its own timeout.

title: Coverage floor covers aura_core only; legacy/platform tree and its Docker-dependent tests have no coverage or infra-free path
current_behavior: api/v2, services/ (JWT, sync) and infrastructure/ are outside the coverage ratchet; four legacy Postgres tests skip anywhere without Docker.
expected_behavior: Coverage reported over the whole shipped tree; the Postgres-backed legacy tests run in the CI postgres job.
recommendation: Add --cov=api --cov=services --cov=infrastructure reporting (no floor initially); move the four testcontainers tests to tests/load/*_postgres.py so the existing postgres service job executes them.

title: Dev/test tooling unpinned (GAP-033 open); no flake, parallel, property-based or mutation tooling
evidence: grep xdist|hypothesis|flaky|mutmut in requirements*.txt: no matches
current_behavior: 4305 tests run serially under whatever pytest/pytest-asyncio resolves on the day; three workflows install them unhashed.
expected_behavior: requirements-dev.lock with hashes consumed by backend-ci, eval-ci and repo-hygiene.
recommendation: Generate requirements-dev.lock with the same uv command as requirements.lock and use it in all three workflows; consider pytest-xdist for the 45-minute test job.

title: Local verification environment diverges from the locked one
evidence: EXECUTED-HERE: pytest --collect-only -> tests/security/test_route_auth.py:125 AttributeError: module 'fastapi.routing' has no attribute 'iter_route_contexts'
current_behavior: The 'tested locally, not CI-run' claims in docs/status/* come from CPython 3.14 with older FastAPI; the route-auth suite that fails on any unprotected route cannot even be collected on it.
expected_behavior: Local runs from the lock on Python 3.11, matching CI.
recommendation: Document a Python 3.11 venv built from requirements.lock as the only sanctioned local path; add a conftest warning when fastapi.__version__ differs from the lock.

title: Certification, training, benchmark and non-Postgres load suites have never produced a passing artefact
current_behavior: The suites exist and skip honestly; none has run against the Railway deployment that is now production.
expected_behavior: One -m cert run with synthetic users on the dev/prod stack, one -m training run, a refreshed load matrix on the current inference plane.
recommendation: Owner-scheduled runs with reports committed under docs/reports/ and the evidence matrix updated (tests/architecture/test_certification_gate.py enforces its wording).

title: Vision eval harness has no threshold, baseline or report
current_behavior: ADR-031 Phase 7 exit criterion (a vision eval report with a pinned model) unmet; only the unit self-test runs.
expected_behavior: A first measured run and an owner-set --min-accuracy.
recommendation: Run --target space/gateway once a vision model is reachable; commit the report.

title: Admin console has no lint gate and about 6 of 10 pages covered by e2e
evidence: aura_admin/package.json:9 (lint: next lint, no ESLint config)
current_behavior: Lint deliberately skipped in CI; four pages have no spec; Admin CI has never run.
expected_behavior: ESLint config committed, npm run lint in CI, one spec per page.
